minutes.headline: Select Board filled several board seats and approved turning the Green Communities task force into a committee.
minutes.summary: The board interviewed applicants and appointed members to the agricultural, conservation, council on aging, historical, public access cable and zoning boards, plus a constable. It approved a charge converting the Green Communities task force into a standing committee with associate members, to be advertised. It also heard a 40B comprehensive permit heads-up, a town manager and COVID update, reassigned committee liaisons, and entered executive session.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved a charge converting the Green Communities task force into a standing committee, with changes; the task force continues until the committee is formed.
Committee openings, including two associate seats on the new Green Communities committee, are to be advertised through the regular process.
The board appointed or reappointed members to the agricultural, conservation, council on aging, historical and public access cable boards, with several of those votes not audible.
Zoning board of appeals and constable reappointments were moved, but the outcomes were not audible; the town manager's annual appointments were postponed to next week.
The board reassigned school committee, finance committee, economic development and land acquisition liaison roles, and heard a 40B comprehensive permit heads-up.

why_it_matters: The Green Communities change creates a standing town committee with open seats residents can apply for, once the openings are advertised.
The 40B comprehensive permit item is an early notice that a housing proposal may later come before local boards, though this meeting took no vote on it.
watch_next: Advertised openings for the Green Communities committee, including two associate seats.
Next week's goals workshop and the postponed town manager annual appointments; the June 15 meeting must be in person unless legislation passes.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on most appointment votes, the Green Communities charge and the library and warrant figures. They differ on the term lengths and on how the conservation commission and ZBA appointments are recorded. The main thing to check is that the official minutes record no ZBA vote and print no result for the Conservation Commission motion, while ours show Conservation passed and the ZBA votes as not audible.
